correctness.rationale: The quandle identity with x=k−1 and y=k makes consecutive differences of any endomorphism constant; conversely every ax+b preserves the operation, including at p=2. Commutation is the vanishing of the minors of the two-row matrix (u;b), where u_i=a_i−1. With h the minimum truncated valuation of u, dividing u by p^h and reducing b modulo p^{e−h} gives a unit pivot if h<e. The reduced b is one scalar multiple of the reduced u and there are p^{ht} lifts; for h=e all translations are free. This yields p^{e+(t−1)h}. A nonunit slope forces h=0. The valuation counts c_ν and the capped sum of valuations of the product give the asserted weights. Summing the translation count over h gives the stated total; subtraction of the baseline p^{e(t+1)} puts the excess entirely in the all-unit cell. This also gives the identity at t=1, the 9153-example, and the multiplicative rank exponents under Chinese remaindering. Separate pointwise enumeration for (2,2,3) matched all 27 nonzero rank profiles with total 400 and all-unit count 176, and sampled h=0,1,2 fibers had respective sizes 4,16,64.
residual_risks: The frozen scripts were inspected, not executed. Finite replay is corroboration only; the arbitrary-p,e,t decision is analytic.

evidence: At a unit u_j the earlier primitive lemma forces b_i=(b_j/u_j)u_i, giving one free scalar. Every singular slope has unit u_j. Summing the free-scalar count over the c_ν slope choices at each prescribed valuation gives exactly p^e times the product of c_ν in all cells except the full-rank cell; the latter is forced by subtraction from the already known total. The product exponent is just the valuation of the product of scalar slopes.

For a fixed nonprimitive row the same unit-coordinate assertion on the reduced ring then gives the displayed lift factor.
